details.description: DeepSeek-V2.5 is a 236-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts chat and coding model, with about 21 billion parameters activated per token, that DeepSeek released on September 5, 2024. DeepSeek's changelog describes it as merging and upgrading the earlier DeepSeek-V2-Chat and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct models into a single model that combines general conversational ability with coding capability, with better alignment to human preferences and improved writing and instruction-following than either predecessor. Model use is governed by DeepSeek's Model License, while the DeepSeek-V2 code is released under the MIT License.
advantages: Scores 89 on HumanEval (Python), up from 84.5 for the prior DeepSeek-V2-0628 and 87.2 for DeepSeek-Coder-V2-0724, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 41.8 on LiveCodeBench (01-09), up from 36.6 and 39.7 for its two predecessor models, per DeepSeek's model card.
DeepSeek reports an Arena-Hard win rate of 76.2%, up from 68.3% and 66.3% for its two predecessor models, per its model card.
Merges DeepSeek-V2-Chat and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct into one model with both general chat and coding ability, per DeepSeek's release notes.
Scores 78.3 on DeepSeek's internal DS-FIM-Eval fill-in-the-middle benchmark, per its model card.
disadvantages: Its SWE-bench Verified score of 16.8 is lower than the 19 scored by its DeepSeek-Coder-V2-0724 predecessor, per DeepSeek's own benchmark table.
DeepSeek's reference deployment example needs 8 GPUs with 80GB of memory each for BF16 inference, per its model card.
Text-only model; its model card documents no vision input support.

DeepSeek's current API pricing page no longer lists deepseek-v2.5 among its models, which as of September 2026 offer only newer DeepSeek-V4-generation models, indicating this model has been superseded.
use_cases: General-purpose chat combined with coding assistance in one model.
Code generation, completion and understanding across programming languages.

notes: Catalog's max_input/output tokens (32768) are lower than the 163,840-token max_position_embeddings in this model's own Hugging Face config.json (reached via YaRN RoPE scaling from a 4,096-token base); kept the catalog's figure per instructions and flagging the disagreement here. DeepSeek's current API pricing page (checked 2026-09-25) no longer lists deepseek-v2.5 among its models, offering only deepseek-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) and deepseek-v4-pro; DeepSeek has released several newer model generations since V2.5's September 2024 launch, and this model has been superseded. No model-specific GitHub repository was found (DeepSeek's DeepSeek-V2 repo covers V2 and V2-Lite but does not mention V2.5), so github_url is left null.
